publish-source-channel.description: Channel parsed from the publish-gate source ref

publish-source-line.description: Line parsed from the publish-gate source ref

publish-source-consumer-version.description: Consumer version parsed from the publish-gate source ref

controller-plan-artifact.description: Uploaded build-channel-router controller plan artifact name

controller-plan-digest.description: Digest of the build-channel-router controller plan

controller-receipt-digest.description: Digest of the build-channel-router controller receipt

entries.interfaceSource:
on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      buildchain-channel:
        description: "Buildchain runtime channel: auto, alpha, or stable"
        default: auto
        type: string
        required: false
      buildchain-alpha-contract-lock-path:
        description: Consumer-owned contract lock selected for the alpha channel
        default: .buildchain/alpha-contract-lock.json
        type: string
        required: false
      buildchain-stable-contract-lock-path:
        description: Consumer-owned contract lock selected for the stable channel
        default: .buildchain/contract-lock.json
        type: string
        required: false
      buildchain-repository:
        default: kungfu-systems/buildchain
        type: string
        required: false
      buildchain-ref:
        description: Official floating Buildchain channel, protected authority, or a
          temporary train/SHA for trusted manual validation.
        default: ""
        type: string
        required: false
      buildchain-expected-channel:
        description: Explicit stable or alpha lane expected by a trusted channel router
          when the workflow shell ref is opaque
        default: ""
        type: string
        required: false
      buildchain-expected-major:
        description: Explicit Buildchain major expected by a trusted channel router when
          the workflow shell ref is opaque
        default: ""
        type: string
        required: false
      buildchain-contract-lock-path:
        description: Consumer-owned Buildchain contract lock path
        default: ""
        type: string
        required: false
      buildchain-contract-compatibility-policy:
        description: "Contract compatibility policy: major-compatible, allow-additive,
          or exact"
        default: major-compatible
        type: string
        required: false
      buildchain-contract-drift-issue-mode:
        description: "Consumer issue behavior for Buildchain floating-ref contract
          drift: off, breaking-only, or compatible-and-breaking"
        default: compatible-and-breaking
        type: string
        required: false
      working-directory:
        default: .
        type: string
        required: false
      runner-preset:
        description: "Runner preset: github-hosted, kungfu-v4-self-hosted,
          aws-us-codebuild-linux, aws-us-ec2-windows-jit, aws-us-ec2-macos-jit,
          or custom with platforms-json"
        default: github-hosted
        type: string
        required: false
      aws-codebuild-project:
        description: Required CodeBuild project name for the explicit
          aws-us-codebuild-linux burst preset
        default: ""
        type: string
        required: false
      aws-ec2-windows-runner-label:
        description: Required unique card-scoped JIT label for the explicit
          aws-us-ec2-windows-jit burst preset
        default: ""
        type: string
        required: false
      aws-ec2-macos-runner-label:
        description: Required unique campaign-scoped JIT label for the explicit
          aws-us-ec2-macos-jit burst preset
        default: ""
        type: string
        required: false
      platforms-json:
        description: "Optional custom JSON array of platform objects: id, name, runner
          JSON string, and optional githubHosted boolean"
        default: ""
        type: string
        required: false
      self-hosted-offline-fallback:
        description: Route each supported exact-label self-hosted lane to its
          GitHub-hosted runner when no matching runner is online
        default: false
        type: boolean
        required: false
      control-runner-json:
        description: JSON runner-label array for trusted control-plane jobs
        default: '["ubuntu-24.04"]'
        type: string
        required: false
      artifact-finalization-command:
        description: Optional consumer verification command over final artifact bytes
          before manifest resealing
        default: ""
        type: string
        required: false
      artifact-finalization-on-platform:
        description: Run trusted artifact finalization on each GitHub-hosted platform
          runner instead of the control runner
        default: false
        type: boolean
        required: false
      fail-fast:
        description: Cancel sibling platform lanes after a required matrix failure;
          false retains all-platform diagnostics
        default: false
        type: boolean
        required: false
      linux-container-preset:
        description: "Optional Linux job container preset: kungfu-verify, none, or
          custom with linux-container-image"
        default: ""
        type: string
        required: false
      linux-container-image:
        description: Optional explicit Linux job container image, preferably pinned by
          digest
        default: ""
        type: string
        required: false
      require-trusted-event:
        default: true
        type: boolean
        required: false
      untrusted-policy:
        description: fail or skip when an untrusted fork event asks for build execution
        default: fail
        type: string
        required: false
      publish-channel:
        description: "Publish channel requested by the caller: none, alpha, release,
          major, or a custom channel from publish-refs-json"
        default: none
        type: string
        required: false
      publish-refs-json:
        description: Optional JSON object mapping publish channels to allowed Git ref
          regular expressions
        default: ""
        type: string
        required: false
      publish-source-ref:
        description: Optional source branch such as publish-gate/alpha/<line>/<version>
          to resolve and lock before build
        default: ""
        type: string
        required: false
      publish-anchor-request-json:
        description: Required JSON request when publish-source-ref resolves to
          publish-gate/anchor
        default: ""
        type: string
        required: false
      publish-registry:
        description: Registry recorded in the resolved publish source manifest
        default: https://registry.npmjs.org/
        type: string
        required: false
      setup-node:
        default: true
        type: boolean
        required: false
      node-version:
        default: "24"
        type: string
        required: false
      setup-rust:
        description: Install a Rust toolchain for native lifecycle jobs
        default: false
        type: boolean
        required: false
      rust-toolchain:
        description: Rust toolchain installed when setup-rust is enabled
        default: stable
        type: string
        required: false
      rustup-dist-server:
        description: Optional rustup distribution mirror; empty uses the official Rust
          server
        default: ""
        type: string
        required: false
      rustup-update-root:
        description: Optional rustup self-update mirror; empty uses the official Rust server
        default: ""
        type: string
        required: false
      cargo-registry-index:
        description: Optional crates.io-compatible Cargo registry index; empty uses the
          Cargo default
        default: ""
        type: string
        required: false
      install-command:
        default: ""
        type: string
        required: false
      build-command:
        default: ""
        type: string
        required: false
      verify-command:
        default: ""
        type: string
        required: false
      verify-substage-evidence-path:
        description: Optional lifecycle verify substage evidence path produced by the
          consumer command
        default: ""
        type: string
        required: false
      kfd-agent-hub:
        description: "Agent Hub conformance mode: off or auto. Auto reads
          .buildchain/kfd/agent-hub.json and runs the fixed KFD suite."
        default: off
        type: string
        required: false
      lifecycle-timeout-minutes:
        description: Maximum minutes for the build matrix job and fallback timeout for
          each lifecycle stage
        default: 120
        type: number
        required: false
      require-install:
        default: false
        type: boolean
        required: false
      require-build:
        default: true
        type: boolean
        required: false
      require-verify:
        default: false
        type: boolean
        required: false
      artifact-name:
        default: buildchain-artifact
        type: string
        required: false
      artifact-name-template:
        description: "Artifact name template with placeholders: {artifact}, {platform},
          {sha}, {shortSha}, {runId}, {runAttempt}"
        default: "{artifact}-{platform}-{sha}"
        type: string
        required: false
      artifact-paths:
        default: |
          dist
          build/stage
        type: string
        required: false
      pre-upload-transport-smoke-scenario-path:
        description: Optional declarative demo scenario, relative to working-directory,
          whose transport smoke must pass before Linux artifact upload
        default: ""
        type: string
        required: false
      pre-upload-transport-smoke-artifact-root:
        description: Artifact root, relative to working-directory, used by the
          pre-upload transport simulation
        default: .
        type: string
        required: false
      credential-island-macos-app-path:
        description: Optional exact .app path to seal for a protected macOS
          credential-island job
        default: ""
        type: string
        required: false
      credential-island-environment:
        description: Protected environment used by the built-in signer; leave empty for
          caller-owned signing
        default: ""
        type: string
        required: false
      credential-island-caller-owned:
        description: Seal and export the macOS input/runtime for a caller-owned
          protected signing job instead of running the built-in signer
        default: false
        type: boolean
        required: false
      credential-island-macos-platform-id:
        description: macOS build platform whose sealed app is admitted to the credential
          island
        default: macos-arm64
        type: string
        required: false
      github-artifact-attestation-subject-path:
        description: Optional exact artifact path to bind to a GitHub keyless
          attestation policy after the final platform manifest is sealed
        default: ""
        type: string
        required: false
      github-artifact-attestation-signer-sha:
        description: Exact 40-hex Buildchain commit containing the trusted reusable
          signer workflow
        default: ""
        type: string
        required: false
      github-artifact-attestation-platform-id:
        description: Linux platform id that owns github-artifact-attestation-subject-path
        default: linux-x64
        type: string
        required: false
      release-candidate:
        description: Generate and upload a PR-stage release-candidate passport after the
          full platform matrix succeeds
        default: false
        type: boolean
        required: false
      expected-artifacts-json:
        description: Optional JSON expectation contract for final artifact files
        default: ""
        type: string
        required: false
      process-summary-path:
        description: Optional process sampler summary JSON path, relative to workspace,
          to embed in final diagnostics
        default: ""
        type: string
        required: false
      sample-process-tree:
        description: Wrap the build lifecycle with the process tree sampler
        default: true
        type: boolean
        required: false
      process-sample-interval-ms:
        description: Process sampler interval in milliseconds
        default: 15000
        type: number
        required: false
      requested-parallelism:
        description: Optional expected build parallelism recorded in process diagnostics
        default: 0
        type: number
        required: false
      artifact-retention-days:
        default: 14
        type: number
        required: false
      artifact-compression-level:
        description: GitHub Artifact payload compression level (0-9); zero avoids
          recompressing release archives and reduces signed-URL exposure
        default: 0
        type: number
        required: false
      artifact-signing-request-upload-no-proxy:
        description: Optional NO_PROXY value scoped only to Buildchain-owned signing
          request uploads; signed-result downloads retain the runner route
        default: ""
        type: string
        required: false
      artifact-transfer-mode:
        description: "Artifact transfer policy: GitHub-hosted platforms always upload
          natively; other platforms use github-artifacts or
          s3-to-github-artifacts"
        default: github-artifacts
        type: string
        required: false
      artifact-relay-s3-bucket:
        description: Optional S3 bucket for artifact relay. Empty may use
          BUILDCHAIN_ARTIFACT_RELAY_S3_BUCKET repo/org variable.
        default: ""
        type: string
        required: false
      artifact-relay-s3-region:
        description: Optional S3 region for artifact relay. Empty may use
          BUILDCHAIN_ARTIFACT_RELAY_S3_REGION repo/org variable.
        default: ""
        type: string
        required: false
      artifact-relay-s3-prefix:
        description: Optional S3 key prefix for artifact relay. Empty may use
          BUILDCHAIN_ARTIFACT_RELAY_S3_PREFIX repo/org variable.
        default: ""
        type: string
        required: false
      artifact-relay-s3-role-arn:
        description: Optional shared OIDC role ARN for S3 relay upload/download. Prefer
          repo/org variables or secrets.
        default: ""
        type: string
        required: false
      artifact-relay-s3-upload-role-arn:
        description: Optional upload OIDC role ARN for self-hosted build runners.
        default: ""
        type: string
        required: false
      artifact-relay-s3-download-role-arn:
        description: Optional download OIDC role ARN for the GitHub-hosted relay runner.
        default: ""
        type: string
        required: false
      artifact-relay-s3-oidc-audience:
        description: Optional OIDC audience for S3 relay roles. Defaults to
          sts.amazonaws.com.cn for cn-* regions, otherwise sts.amazonaws.com.
        default: ""
        type: string
        required: false
      checkout-cache-mode:
        description: "Locked source checkout cache mode: off, auto, or require"
        default: off
        type: string
        required: false
      checkout-cache-mirror-url-template:
        description: Trusted local/LAN Git mirror URL template. Supports {owner},
          {repo}, {repository}, {repositorySlug}, and {sha}.
        default: ""
        type: string
        required: false
      checkout-cache-reference-repository-template:
        description: Trusted runner-local bare reference repository template. Supports
          {owner}, {repo}, {repository}, {repositorySlug}, and {sha}.
        default: ""
        type: string
        required: false
      checkout-cache-fallback:
        description: "Fallback when checkout cache misses: github or fail"
        default: github
        type: string
        required: false
      checkout-cache-timeout-seconds:
        description: Timeout for each trusted cache transport attempt
        default: 60
        type: number
        required: false
      checkout-cache-github-timeout-seconds:
        description: Timeout for each GitHub fallback fetch attempt
        default: 600
        type: number
        required: false
      checkout-cache-fetch-attempts:
        description: Maximum bounded attempts for retryable GitHub fallback fetch failures
        default: 3
        type: number
        required: false
      checkout-history-mode:
        description: "Locked consumer source history: shallow or full. Full retains
          ancestry required by source-history gates."
        default: shallow
        type: string
        required: false
      shifu-cache-profile-ref:
        description: Opaque trusted Shifu cache profile reference passed to lifecycle
          commands without interpretation
        default: ""
        type: string
        required: false
      shifu-cache-profile-digest:
        description: Opaque expected Shifu cache profile digest passed to lifecycle
          commands without interpretation
        default: ""
        type: string
        required: false
      cache-dependency-lock-root:
        description: Optional consumer-owned exact dependency-lock root bound into
          structured cache evidence
        default: ""
        type: string
        required: false
      cache-toolchain-root:
        description: Optional consumer-owned exact toolchain root bound into structured
          cache evidence
        default: ""
        type: string
        required: false
      cache-policy-root:
        description: Optional consumer-owned exact qualification policy root bound into
          structured cache evidence
        default: ""
        type: string
        required: false
      compiler-cache-provider:
        description: "Audited compiler cache provider prepared before build: none or
          sccache"
        default: none
        type: string
        required: false
      compiler-cache-platforms-json:
        description: JSON array of platform ids on which compiler-cache preparation is
          enabled
        default: "[]"
        type: string
        required: false
      compiler-cache-required:
        description: Fail the selected platform before build when the compiler cache
          cannot be prepared
        default: false
        type: boolean
        required: false
      gate-profile-aggregate-json:
        description: Optional qualifying buildchain.shifu-gate-aggregate/v1 JSON from
          the reusable Gate workflow
        default: ""
        type: string
        required: false
      release-candidate-family-evidence-json:
        description: Optional exact Initiative-family release evidence JSON embedded in
          the release-candidate passport
        default: ""
        type: string
        required: false
      config-path:
        description: Locate buildchain.toml when the project cannot be discovered.
        type: string
        required: false
        default: ""
      runtime-ref:
        description: Transient execution runtime; empty selects the consumer lock.
        type: string
        required: false
        default: ""
      contract-lock:
        description: Optional consumer runtime contract lock path.
        type: string
        required: false
        default: ""
      resume-run-id:
        description: Failed execution to resume using its original source and retained
          build outputs.
        type: string
        required: false
        default: ""
      runtime-selection:
        description: Entry-resolved runtime transport for nested workflows.
        type: string
        required: false
        default: ""
    secrets:
      BUILDCHAIN_ARTIFACT_RELAY_S3_ROLE_ARN:
        required: false
      BUILDCHAIN_ARTIFACT_RELAY_S3_UPLOAD_ROLE_ARN:
        required: false
      BUILDCHAIN_ARTIFACT_RELAY_S3_DOWNLOAD_ROLE_ARN:
        required: false
      BUILDCHAIN_MACOS_CERTIFICATE_P12_BASE64:
        required: false
      BUILDCHAIN_MACOS_CERTIFICATE_PASSWORD:
        required: false
      BUILDCHAIN_MACOS_NOTARY_API_KEY_P8_BASE64:
        required: false
      BUILDCHAIN_MACOS_NOTARY_API_KEY_ID:
        required: false
      BUILDCHAIN_MACOS_NOTARY_API_ISSUER:
        required: false
      BUILDCHAIN_PROMOTION_TOKEN:
        required: false
    outputs:
      result:
        description: Rooted build result and exact artifact references.
        value: ${{ jobs.build.outputs.result }}
      release-candidate-artifact:
        description: Uploaded release-candidate passport artifact name when
          release-candidate is enabled
        value: ${{
          fromJSON(jobs.build.outputs.result).historical_outputs['release-candidate-artifact']
          }}
      controller-receipt-artifact:
        description: Uploaded build-channel-router controller receipt artifact name
        value: ${{
          fromJSON(jobs.build.outputs.result).historical_outputs['controller-receipt-artifact']
          }}
      buildchain-channel:
        description: "Resolved Buildchain channel: alpha or stable"
        value: ${{
          fromJSON(jobs.build.outputs.result).historical_outputs['buildchain-channel']
          }}
      buildchain-channel-selection-source:
        description: Evidence source used to select the Buildchain channel
        value: ${{
          fromJSON(jobs.build.outputs.result).historical_outputs['buildchain-channel-selection-source']
          }}
      buildchain-channel-reason:
        description: Human-readable Buildchain channel selection reason
        value: ${{
          fromJSON(jobs.build.outputs.result).historical_outputs['buildchain-channel-reason']
          }}
      runner-preset:
        description: Resolved runner preset name
        value: ${{
          fromJSON(jobs.build.outputs.result).historical_outputs['runner-preset']
          }}
      platforms-json:
        description: Resolved platform matrix JSON
        value: ${{
          fromJSON(jobs.build.outputs.result).historical_outputs['platforms-json']
          }}
      runner-routing-json:
        description: De-identified self-hosted availability and offline fallback decision
        value: ${{
          fromJSON(jobs.build.outputs.result).historical_outputs['runner-routing-json']
          }}
      platform-count:
        description: Resolved platform count
        value: ${{
          fromJSON(jobs.build.outputs.result).historical_outputs['platform-count']
          }}
      linux-container-enabled:
        description: Whether Linux build platforms are routed through a job container
        value: ${{
          fromJSON(jobs.build.outputs.result).historical_outputs['linux-container-enabled']
          }}
      linux-container-image:
        description: Resolved Linux job container image
        value: ${{
          fromJSON(jobs.build.outputs.result).historical_outputs['linux-container-image']
          }}
      build-summary-artifact:
        description: Uploaded aggregate build summary artifact name
        value: ${{
          fromJSON(jobs.build.outputs.result).historical_outputs['build-summary-artifact']
          }}
      credential-island-macos-artifact:
        description: Uploaded signed macOS payload artifact name when the credential
          island is enabled
        value: ${{
          fromJSON(jobs.build.outputs.result).historical_outputs['credential-island-macos-artifact']
          }}
      credential-island-macos-manifest-artifact:
        description: Uploaded signed macOS manifest artifact name when the credential
          island is enabled
        value: ${{
          fromJSON(jobs.build.outputs.result).historical_outputs['credential-island-macos-manifest-artifact']
          }}
      build-diagnostics-summary-artifact:
        description: Uploaded aggregate diagnostics summary artifact name
        value: ${{
          fromJSON(jobs.build.outputs.result).historical_outputs['build-diagnostics-summary-artifact']
          }}
      release-candidate-passport-artifact:
        description: Uploaded release-candidate passport artifact name when
          release-candidate is enabled
        value: ${{
          fromJSON(jobs.build.outputs.result).historical_outputs['release-candidate-passport-artifact']
          }}
      release-candidate-passport-json:
        description: Compact release-candidate passport JSON when release-candidate is
          enabled
        value: ${{
          fromJSON(jobs.build.outputs.result).historical_outputs['release-candidate-passport-json']
          }}
      build-summary-json:
        description: Compact aggregate build summary JSON
        value: ${{
          fromJSON(jobs.build.outputs.result).historical_outputs['build-summary-json']
          }}
      artifact-coordinates-json:
        description: Producer-owned exact GitHub Artifact coordinates for every resolved
          build platform
        value: ${{
          fromJSON(jobs.build.outputs.result).historical_outputs['artifact-coordinates-json']
          }}
      build-diagnostics-summary-json:
        description: Compact aggregate diagnostics summary JSON with lifecycle,
          diagnostics contract warning, and sidecar manifest warning totals
        value: ${{
          fromJSON(jobs.build.outputs.result).historical_outputs['build-diagnostics-summary-json']
          }}
      trusted-event:
        description: Whether the event is trusted enough to run build jobs
        value: ${{
          fromJSON(jobs.build.outputs.result).historical_outputs['trusted-event']
          }}
      buildchain-runtime-ref:
        description: Resolved Buildchain runtime ref
        value: ${{
          fromJSON(jobs.build.outputs.result).historical_outputs['buildchain-runtime-ref']
          }}
      buildchain-runtime-sha:
        description: Resolved immutable Buildchain runtime SHA
        value: ${{
          fromJSON(jobs.build.outputs.result).historical_outputs['buildchain-runtime-sha']
          }}
      buildchain-runtime-class:
        description: "Runtime stability class: stable, alpha, authority, train,
          exact-sha, or development"
        value: ${{
          fromJSON(jobs.build.outputs.result).historical_outputs['buildchain-runtime-class']
          }}
      buildchain-runtime-override:
        description: Whether an authority, train, or exact-SHA buildchain-ref override
          was used
        value: ${{
          fromJSON(jobs.build.outputs.result).historical_outputs['buildchain-runtime-override']
          }}
      buildchain-runtime-trust-decision:
        description: Runtime override trust decision
        value: ${{
          fromJSON(jobs.build.outputs.result).historical_outputs['buildchain-runtime-trust-decision']
          }}
      buildchain-contract-lock-status:
        description: Floating Buildchain runtime contract lock status
        value: ${{
          fromJSON(jobs.build.outputs.result).historical_outputs['buildchain-contract-lock-status']
          }}
      buildchain-contract-lock-drift:
        description: Whether the floating Buildchain runtime SHA or contract digest
          drifted from the consumer lock
        value: ${{
          fromJSON(jobs.build.outputs.result).historical_outputs['buildchain-contract-lock-drift']
          }}
      buildchain-contract-digest:
        description: Current Buildchain runtime contract digest
        value: ${{
          fromJSON(jobs.build.outputs.result).historical_outputs['buildchain-contract-digest']
          }}
      publish-channel:
        description: Resolved publish channel
        value: ${{
          fromJSON(jobs.build.outputs.result).historical_outputs['publish-channel']
          }}
      publish-allowed:
        description: Whether this event/ref may publish after successful verification
        value: ${{
          fromJSON(jobs.build.outputs.result).historical_outputs['publish-allowed']
          }}
      publish-reason:
        description: Human-readable publish gate reason
        value: ${{
          fromJSON(jobs.build.outputs.result).historical_outputs['publish-reason']
          }}
      publish-source-ref:
        description: Resolved publish source ref
        value: ${{
          fromJSON(jobs.build.outputs.result).historical_outputs['publish-source-ref']
          }}
      publish-source-sha:
        description: Locked source SHA used for checkout/build/summary
        value: ${{
          fromJSON(jobs.build.outputs.result).historical_outputs['publish-source-sha']
          }}
      publish-source-tree-sha:
        description: Git tree SHA for the locked source commit used by release-candidate
          promotion equivalence checks
        value: ${{
          fromJSON(jobs.build.outputs.result).historical_outputs['publish-source-tree-sha']
          }}
      publish-source-locked:
        description: Whether a publish-gate source ref was explicitly locked
        value: ${{
          fromJSON(jobs.build.outputs.result).historical_outputs['publish-source-locked']
          }}
      publish-source-channel:
        description: Channel parsed from the publish-gate source ref
        value: ${{
          fromJSON(jobs.build.outputs.result).historical_outputs['publish-source-channel']
          }}
      publish-source-line:
        description: Line parsed from the publish-gate source ref
        value: ${{
          fromJSON(jobs.build.outputs.result).historical_outputs['publish-source-line']
          }}
      publish-source-consumer-version:
        description: Consumer version parsed from the publish-gate source ref
        value: ${{
          fromJSON(jobs.build.outputs.result).historical_outputs['publish-source-consumer-version']
          }}
      release-manifest-json:
        description: Resolved release manifest JSON
        value: ${{
          fromJSON(jobs.build.outputs.result).historical_outputs['release-manifest-json']
          }}
      controller-plan-artifact:
        description: Uploaded build-channel-router controller plan artifact name
        value: ${{
          fromJSON(jobs.build.outputs.result).historical_outputs['controller-plan-artifact']
          }}
      controller-plan-json:
        description: Compact source/runtime-bound build-channel-router controller plan
        value: ${{
          fromJSON(jobs.build.outputs.result).historical_outputs['controller-plan-json']
          }}
      controller-plan-digest:
